Load and cache the dataset index.

Source: R/index.R
load_index.Rd

These functions are used to load and cache the dataset record index from the index.json file in the safedata directory (see set_safedata_dir).

Usage

safedata_env

load_index()

get_index()

Value

The load_index function loads and caches the index data, checks the availability of datasets and checks for user modifications to the safedata directory structure but does not return the index data. Use the get_index function to retrieve the data from the cache.

Details

When any of the three core resource files (index.json, gazetteer.geojson and location_aliases.csv) are loaded, the file contents are cached in a separate R environment (safedata_env) to reduce file loading while the package is being used. This environment is not intended to be accessed by users and changing the contents will break package functionality.

Functions

  • safedata_env: The caching environment for core resource data

  • load_index(): Load and cache dataset index data.

  • get_index(): Return the cached index data

See also

load_location_aliases, load_gazetteer
